ControlEntry.description: One fader: a source, how hard to push it, and where.

strength.description: Multiplier on the source's unit direction (times its calibration scale once known). 0 = off.
strength.title: Strength

layers.description: Decoder layers to add the direction at. Default: the source's own layer.
layers.title: Layers

mode.description: add (the default when absent): add strength × the unit direction. clamp (SAE features only, at the SAE's layer): set the feature's activation to strength every token, by adding (strength - activation) × its decoder vector.
mode.title: Mode

ControlEntry.title: ControlEntry

DirectionSource.description: A named direction, e.g. one of the repo's difference-of-means directions (sandbagging, refusal, chinese).
DirectionSource.title: DirectionSource

SAESource.description: An SAE feature: `release` and `layer` pick the SAE, `feature` the decoder direction inside it.

release.description: Hub repo id of the SAE release, e.g. google/gemma-scope-2-1b-it.
release.title: Release

layer.description: Decoder layer the SAE was trained on.
layer.title: Layer

SAESource.title: SAESource

description: Live steering state, re-read by the engine before every generated token. Write a new version to a temp file and rename it over this one; the engine re-reads it every token.

model.description: The model this file steers; entries are ignored for any other.
model.title: Model
